'''Twin Suns Five''' was the callsign of an unknown [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] within [[Twin Suns Squadron]]. During the [[Second Battle of Bilbringi]], Twin Suns Five was sent with [[Twin Suns Six]] and [[Jagged Fel]] to escape the system and find [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]].<ref name="FP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>

*''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''{{1st}}
